newsitems.contents: [p]Hello Daevas,[/p][p][/p][p]We will be performing our scheduled game server maintenance. During the maintenance, the game login will be temporarily unavailable.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Details:[/u][/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="151,"][tr][th colwidth="151"][p]When:[/p][/th][td][p]October 4, 2026 at 22:00 PDT / October 5, 2026 at 07:00 CEST[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="151"][p]​Duration:[/p][/th][td][p]​8 hours[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="151"][p]Affected Services:[/p][/th][td][p]Game servers[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b][u]Main Update Details:[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Advanced Access period ends.[/p][/*][*][p]Commercial launch begins.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Other Improvements and Bug Fixes:[/u][/b][/p][p][b]Improvements [/b][/p][list][*][p]The requirements for deleting a character will change. [/p][list][*][p]The character deletion waiting period will be shortened from 168 hours to 24 hours. [/p][/*][*][p]The minimum level required to delete a character will be changed from Level 10 to Level 1. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The wait time before being redirected to the server selection screen when no input is entered will be adjusted from 30 minutes to 3 hours. [/p][/*][*][p]The duration of in-game announcements will be changed from 3 seconds to 10 seconds. [/p][/*][*][p]Improvements will be made to allow for smoother interaction with objects required for quest progression. [/p][list][*][p]Some objects will no longer disappear, and the respawn time for others will be shortened. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The stats of some bosses will be adjusted, as they are currently set too low for the intended difficulty of a five-player party. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes [/b][/p][list][*][p]An issue where characters would occasionally return to their previous position when approaching other players while using Auto Move during a quest will be fixed. [/p][/*][*][p]An error affecting the use of the Journal - newsitems.title: [Notice] New Server and Matchmaking Information
newsitems.author: nc_community
newsitems.contents: [p]Hello Daevas,[/p][p][/p][p]The starting line up for the global commercial launch servers are available![/p][p]In AION 2, each server houses only one faction. Every Elyos server is paired with an Asmodian counterpart, giving both factions their own home while still meeting in shared PvP spaces like the Abyss. When you launch Aion 2, you’ll first choose your Region, then your Faction, and finally select from the available servers in that region.[/p][h2][b]What is Server Matchmaking?[/b][/h2][p]In Aion 2, the Elyos and Asmodians each live on their own servers. But the war between the factions doesn't stay behind borders for long. As you journey through Atreia, you'll get chances to face the opposing faction in modes such as [b]Spacetime Rifts[/b] and [b]the Abyss[/b]. To bring the two sides together, each Elyos server is paired with an Asmodian server for a limited time. Whenever you enter the Abyss or another cross-faction mode, the players you meet from the other faction will come from your matched server. [/p][p] [/p][p]For example, if the Asmodian server [b]Israphel[/b] is paired with the Elyos server [b]Siel[/b], every Israphel Asmodian who enters the Abyss will run into Siel's Elyos. Those are the players you'll be clashing with, competing against, and… holding grudges against.  [/p][p][/p][h2][u][b]Server and Matchmaking List[/b][/u][/h2][p]*Please refer to this notice for the newsitems.title: Founder's Packs cosmetics soon available on all characters
newsitems.author: [NC] Fedal
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello, Daevas![/p][p][/p][p]First, we want to say thank you. We're grateful for the enthusiasm and support you've shown since the start of Early Access, as well as the time you've taken to send us so much feedback. We are currently reviewing all feedback and considering it from various angles. Among this feedback, we've confirmed that many Daevas have found the outfits provided in the Founders Pack to be a significant obstacle when playing with friends on different servers, or when leveling up other classes. To allow players to enjoy a freer and more fun experience, we've decided to change the Founders Pack outfits so that they are available to all characters across all servers.[/p][p]

[b]What is changing[/b]

Once implemented, you will be able to use the cosmetics included in your Founder's Pack on every character on your account, on any server.

The cosmetics you may use is based on the pack you purchased:

[u]Standard Founder's Pack[/u]
- Unique Title \[Vanguard of Atreia]

[u]Deluxe Founder's Pack[/u]
- Unique Title \[Vanguard of Atreia]
- Armor Skin \[Ascended Daeva]
- Weapon Skin \[Eternal Sun]

[u]Ultimate Founder's Pack[/u]
- Unique Title \[Vanguard of Atreia]
- Armor Skin \[Ascended Daeva]
- Weapon Skin \[Eternal Sun]
- Armor Skin \[Moonlit Aria]
- Pet \[Black Dragon]
- Wings \[Blazing Sun] 

Ineligible items: the 30-day membership, the Daeva's Campaign Supply Chest, the Daeva's Styling Chest and their contents. These remain one-time rewards and keep their current rules.

[b]When will this happen?[/b]

We ask for a little patience while we work through implementing the change allowing the Founder’s Packs cosmetics to be distributed to all characters on all servers. It may still take several days, and the solution will be completed after the end of Early Access. However, today we are committing to you the access on all your characters[b]. [/b]As soon as the approach is confirmed, we will publish a second update covering how your characters will get access, what you need to do, if anything, and when.

[b]What if this changes which Founder's Pack I want? [/b]

Some of you chose a lower tier pack because of the original limitation. If this change makes you want a higher-tier pack, we don't want you to pay twice:
- On Purple, you can upgrade your Founder's Pack to a higher tier.
- On Steam, if you purchase a higher-tier Founder's Pack on the same account, you will be able to request a refund of the lower-priced pack through Customer Support. The exact process will be part of the follow-up update.


This change comes directly from the feedback you shared during Early Access. Early Access is there for us to learn how you play, hear what works and what doesn't, and improve AION 2 with you. Thank you to everyone who took the time to share their thoughts on Founder's Packs. We'll be back with the next update as soon as the solution, process and timeline are confirmed.

See you soon in Atreia![/p]

newsitems.title: Launch FAQ
newsitems.author: NC_Quokka
newsitems.contents:
[p][b]How do I link my Twitch Account to my AION 2 Account?[/b][/p][p]Twitch Drops rewards are delivered to the account that your Twitch account is linked to. If you previously linked a different NC account, the reward will be delivered to that NC account rather than your Steam account. [/p][p]Before claiming AION 2 Twitch Drops, you must first make sure your Twitch account is correctly linked. Check your account linking status by logging into the [url="https://aion2.plaync.com/en-us/index?redirect=false"]official NC website[/url] and going to My Page > Manage Login.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Is AION 2 subscription based?[/b] 
AION 2 is free to play with an optional monthly membership. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]What is the monetization of AION 2?[/b] 
AION 2 offers optional paid cosmetic items, a Battle Pass and a membership to access player-driven economy & currency exchanges. You can check out how the monetization for AION 2 Global looks in detail [u][url="https://aion2.plaync.com/en-us/board/notice/view?articleId=6a4d7d47a729ca5877f5e1ef&redirect=false"]here[/url][/u]. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Can I play this game even if I have no one to play with?[/b] 
Yes, AION 2 can be played solo or with friends!  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Are there any differences between the Steam and Purple versions?[/b] 
No, the in-game content is the same for both Steam and Purple users. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Will any progress from the TW or KR version of the game carry over?[/b] 
No, any progress between the TW/KR and global version will not carry over. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Do I need to link my Purple and Steam accounts?[/b] 
No, you can play on Steam without linking to a Purple account. However, if you want to access the same character and progress on both platforms, you'll need to link your accounts. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]What languages are available in the global version of the game?[/b] 
AION 2 supports the following languages.  [/p][list][*][p]VO: English, Japanese, Korean.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]UI & Subtitles: English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, and Korean. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]How do I change the language of the game?[/b] 
Once you're in the game, click the gear icon in the top right corner to open Settings, then select the language tab and choose your preferred language from the list. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]What regions will be available for the global service?[/b] 
We have confirmed server locations in North America, South America, Europe, and Japan. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Will AION 2 be on mobile?[/b] 
The global version will be available on Steam and PURPLE.   [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Will there be controller support?[/b] [/p][p]While AION 2 is playable with a controller, it is not officially supported. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Are Steam and Purple players on the same servers? [/b] 
Yes, Steam and Purple players will be sharing the same servers. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Will there be Linux or Steam Deck support?[/b] [/p][p]While AION 2 may be playable on other platforms or devices, at this time we will only be providing official support for Steam and PURPLE on Windows PC. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Does AION 2 have an official Discord?[/b] 
Yes, you can join the discussion on our official Discord [url="https://discord.gg/aion2official"]here[/url]. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]How do I contact customer support if I run into an issue?[/b] 
You can reach out to our Customer Support via [url="https://help.plaync.com/"]https://help.plaync.com/[/url]
If you encounter a bug, please join our [url="https://discord.gg/aion2official"][u]Discord[/u][/url] and post the situation in the bug-reports channel!
[/p]
